diff: +/* DIVERGENCE: c_reg.c defines the selected CCPU segment loaders as
+ * ISM32(IU16).  Preserve the generated function shape with its actual
+ * source return carrier so callers and the host selection table agree. */
ledger_candidates: | MVDM-HOST-DIV-506 | Mark unselected non-CCPU alternatives in selected original host headers. | All observed current product object consumers of the three headers define `CCPU`; the owner requires preserved conditionals with numbered exclusion reasons. | Preserve CCPU and software V86 paths and selected `cpu4gen.h` interfaces. Update DIV-146 note; original branch hashes and consumer graph counts: `../../artifacts/mvdm-audit/s12-nonccpu-header-subsets.jsonl`. | Three selected MVDM headers in the ledger. |

| MVDM-HOST-DIV-046 | Declare the selected CCPU flag-read and segment-load callbacks consistently. | The generated header incorrectly uses `IBOOL`/`IUH` where `c_reg.c` defines `ISM32`. | Retain the original callback names and correct the selected generated declarations to their actual `ISM32` contracts. | `softpc.new/base/ccpu386/cpu4gen.h` |

| MVDM-HOST-DIV-048 | Bind the selected CCPU control fields through their generated GDP names. | The historical non-PROD `GdpOffsetFromName` assertion is unavailable in the selected source set, and hard-coded packed offsets obscure the original field contract. | Retain the original x86 64 KiB contiguous GDP allocation and generated macro layout; `nt_cpu.c` names the selected generated fields directly and omits only the unavailable assertion. GDP is private SoftPC state and does not use the session mapping manager. | `softpc.new/base/ccpu386/cpu4gen.h`, `softpc.new/base/cvidc/{ev_glue.c,gdpvar.h}`, `softpc.new/host/src/nt_cpu.c` |
